d: Coral island of the Lakshadweep archipelago in India
x: Kadmat Island, also known as Cardamom Island, is a coral island belonging to the Amindivi subgroup of islands of the Lakshadweep archipelago in India. Measuring 9.3 kilometres in length, the island has a lagoon with a width of 1.5 kilometres covering an area of 25 square kilometres.

Kiltan or Kilthān Island is a coral island in the Amindivi subgroup of the Indian Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It is at a distance of 291 km away from Kannur, 303 km away from Kozhikode, and 394 km west of the city of Kochi. The nearest mainland body is Cannanore and the nearest port is Mangalore.
Bitra, also known as Bitrā Par, is a coral atoll belonging to the Amindivi Subgroup of islands of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep in India. It is 483 km west of the city of Kochi.

d: Island in the Lakshadweep archipelago in India
x: Chetlat Island is an inhabited island in the Union territory of Lakshadweep, India. It is part of the Aminidivi subgroup of islands of the Lakshadweep archipelago in the Arabian Sea. Chetlat is the sole inhabited island of the township of Chetlat Island of Aminidivi Tehsil.

n: Dr KK Mohammed Koya Sea Cucumber Conservation Reserve
x: The Dr. K.K. Mohammed Koya Sea Cucumber Conservation Reserve is a marine protected area located off the coast of the Indian union territory of Lakshadweep, approximately 50 km northwest of the island of Bitra.

x: Byramgore Reef, also known as Chereapani Reef, is a coral atoll belonging to the Amindivi Subgroup of islands of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, India. It has a distance of 1,940 km south of the city of Delhi.

d: Coral atoll in the Amindivi Subgroup of islands of India
x: Cherbaniani Reef, also known as Beleapani Reef, is a coral atoll belonging to the Amindivi Subgroup of islands of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, India. It has a distance of 1,880 km south of the city of Delhi.
